name: phil/receipt-email
description: Email each payment its numbered receipt and each gift its official tax receipt: amounts as issued, a plain-text part, the PDF on request, no tracking.

suggest.phil/commerce-bundle: To read the receipts and credit notes it issues, and attach their PDF
suggest.phil/email-templates-bundle: To render the receipts from templates each site and locale may change
suggest.phil/paged-media: To attach the PDF of a donation receipt
suggest.symfony/mailer: To send the receipts from a Messenger worker, through a transport
suggest.symfony/messenger: To send the receipts asynchronously, with messages that carry identifiers only
